dct_description_sm: Population size, trend and demography of common eiders in coastal habitats of the Alaskan Arctic Coastal Plain. The Arctic Coastal Plain common eider breeding pair survey is designed specifically to monitor the population index, population trend, and distribution of common eiders. Unlike other waterbirds on the Arctic Coastal Plain, common eiders nest almost exclusively on barrier islands - a habitat that is not sampled during the standard ACP breeding pair survey.
dct_title_s: Arctic Coastal Plain Common Eider Breeding Pair Survey
